title: Where It Began
subtitle: Two Paths, One Hello
desc: What started as a brief introduction at a friend's gathering slowly grew into long walks, shared coffee, and the quiet feeling that we had found something rare.
captions: The evening we knew this was different. 🌅

title: The Promise
subtitle: A Ring, A Yes
desc: After countless ordinary days that never felt ordinary with each other, he asked—and she said yes. A small circle of gold, and a promise to keep choosing one another.
caption: She said yes. 💍

title: Forever Begins
subtitle: Two Families, One Story
desc: Surrounded by the people we love most, we walked toward a new chapter—hand in hand, grateful, and ready to begin the rest of our lives together.
descs: Surrounded by the people we love most, we walked toward a new chapter—hand in hand, grateful, and ready to begin the rest of our lives together.
Before family, friends, and God, we made a vow to honor, cherish, and grow old together.
captions: And so our forever officially began. ⛪✨
